scope: No-terminal removal-only component placement from promoted mega donors plus the 20260618 new-component mega donor through src/proteusgen/component_placer.py.

display_rules.anode: Use the accepted mega anode trim rule: trim selected 399-byte middle block-final rows by two bytes, then terminate with the true donor-final anode row.
display_rules.cathode_blue: Use mega cathode rows only as middle rows and terminate with a true donor-final anode sentinel or accepted anode block.
display_rules.4027_display_boundary: For current accepted 4027/display output, preserve the 375-byte D20 diode packet immediately before display rows. D20 is visible; removal is under separate V12 diagnostics.

current_limitations: Display rows are special records and use component_placer.py display extraction rather than ordinary U/R/C/L/D/Q/V/I packet starts.
Common-cathode output uses the accepted 7SEG-COM-CAT-BLUE / 7SEGCOMK mega rows. Red-only cathode output still needs a high-count red mega donor.
D20 is currently required for accepted display coexistence until D20-removal diagnostics prove otherwise.
VSINE is available but should only be emitted when explicitly requested.
